why: Searches found only work on variants (delay differential equations' Kaplan-Yorke periodic solutions, an extension of the Kaplan-Yorke formula to infinite-dimensional Banach-space delay systems in a 2025 paper) and general surveys/applications; nothing addresses or moves the general Kaplan-Yorke conjecture on Lyapunov dimension of attractors as stated.

found.title: Lyapunov Exponents, Kaplan–Yorke Formulas and Dimensions of Attractors for Delay Systems in Banach Spaces
found.note: Extends Kaplan-Yorke formula to infinite-dimensional delay systems in Banach spaces; a generalization to a different setting, not the stated conjecture.

found.title: The number of Kaplan-Yorke periodic solutions for delay differential equations
found.note: Concerns Kaplan-Yorke periodic solutions of delay differential equations, an unrelated namesake topic, not the dimension conjecture.
